name: omp-debate
description: omp extension: adversarial plan/review debates with chat-bubble rendering and smoke suite

scripts.shots:done: freeze --execute "bun shots.ts done" -o docs/debate.png --theme dracula --padding 12 --font.family Menlo
scripts.shots:streaming: freeze --execute "bun shots.ts streaming" -o docs/debate-streaming.png --theme dracula --padding 12 --font.family Menlo
scripts.shots: bun run shots:done && bun run shots:streaming
